column2: NSLOCTEXT("[C862D8D30FA1DD848D39A91224A6FDE7]", "20C708764700F01CB1C67888BF4228A1", "\"Welcome. You must be the new hire, right? The Boss is waiting for you. It should be the room all the way to the far left.\"")

NSLOCTEXT("[C862D8D30FA1DD848D39A91224A6FDE7]", "E4B67D7041D1E5C04138AB8B73D066BF", "\"Hi. Nice to see you could make it. I\'m sure you already know what this job entails? Well, lets put you to the test. I think the janitor could use some help.\"")

NSLOCTEXT("[C862D8D30FA1DD848D39A91224A6FDE7]", "EC4CE3DF45F5A6320A8AB29F08D3C0F8", "\"Well, what do we have here? A Human? Well, don\'t matter. You\'re here. Can you help me with somethin\'? There\'s a lotta trash around. Think you can help?\"")

NSLOCTEXT("[C862D8D30FA1DD848D39A91224A6FDE7]", "BFCA18294779AFFF645868B0CD19EAE6", "\"Hi, I\'m the floor manager of this place. You the one they hired? Man, you don\'t look like much. Do you even eat? Well, whatever.\"")
